jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
  • Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
  • Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
  • Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
  • Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.


Warum wir?

  • Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
  • Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
  • Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
  • Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
  • Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
  • Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
  • Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 


Unser Standort

Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria. 

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager [Klaxoon]
Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

About the Role

Summary

Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

 

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.

 

This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability.

  • A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window.

  • Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.

  • Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release.

  • Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

  • Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

What You'll Do

  • Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy.

  • Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

  • Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.

  • Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release.

  • Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet.

  • Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content.

  • Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface.

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team.

  • Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter.

  • Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually.

  • Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is.

  • Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations.

  • Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it.

  • Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform.

  • Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers.

  • Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security.

  • Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls.

  • Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction.

  • Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Menlo Mindsets

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

  • Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go.

  • Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises.

  • United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.

  • Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.

  • Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.

    • What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research.

About Menlo Security

Menlo Security's mission: Enabling humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely without compromise. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies, to protect their most important asset — their data — and is backed by top-tier investors.

SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

 

What we offer*

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 

The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
  • Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
  • Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Program Manager, Platform & Operations
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms, powered by the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them, and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to ensure Orakl's scientific platform operate as one system. Our platform spans severals functions (biobank, R&D, data science, computational biology, and pharma and hospital partnerships), and each one depends on the others to deliver. Your job is to make they work as pillars for the company: aligned on shared goals, coordinated on dependencies, and measured in a way that reflects both the science and the business.

This is a senior, high-ownership role inside Platform and Operations. You will act as a strategic thought partner to the science leads, build and track the program view of the whole platform, keep everyone working from the same roadmap and the same numbers, anticipate where things will break before they do, and make sure our biobank, our external partners, and our internal research all pull in the same direction. You will also help embed a product mindset across the platform and steward our emerging product department, turning strong science and recurring partner demand into clearly scoped, owned products. You will report to the Head of Platform Strategy and Operations, and work daily with the team leads, BD, and the Alliance Manager who owns partner delivery.

What you'll do

1. Run the cross-functional roadmap

  • Own the cross-functional work breakdown across biobank, data, computational biology and partnerships: owners, priorities, timelines, interdependencies

  • Translate scientific ambitions into executable plans with clear milestones and costs, support each team in building their roadmap and capacity

  • Coordinate technical and scientific roadmap execution, identify opportunities and risks, drive remediation, shape priorities with teams

2. Drive operational excellence

  • Build and run the KPI framework with the Chief of Staff so each pillar's technical metrics roll up into business and strategic KPIs

  • Keep one source of truth for roadmap, KPIs, dependencies and status across Notion, Asana and SharePoint

  • Spot optimization possibilities and drive technical scaling

3. Support platform portfolio management

  • Support the execution of our virtual patients collection strategy, taking into account scientific and clinical capabilities as well as R&D and business needs

  • Contribute to grant writing and manage subsequent collaborative work

  • Coordinate and help arbitrate resource allocation to align them with company goals, supporting both internal development and business execution needs

  • Coordinate the definition and scoping of R&D bricks supporting the development of our current and future products, aligning Product and R&D teams

What we're looking for

Must have

  • Min 5-7 years experience, including at least 3 years in program or portfolio management in an industrial, tech or biotech environment

  • An advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in a life sciences, computational biology, computer science or related field

  • Understanding of drug discovery and development, ideally in the field of oncology

  • Experience building KPIs or OKR reporting

  • Exposure to product management or product operations, ideally in a scientific or technical setting

  • Comfortable in fast paced environments, navigating ambiguity and adapting plans as things change, without losing the thread and focus

  • Genuine curiosity for both data/AI and biology worlds: you enjoy talking metrics and delivery with wet and dry scientists and engineers

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder skills across all levels of the organisation, up to founder level

  • Fluency with the tools we use (or similar ones) to run this: Notion, Asana, SharePoint, and dash-boarding

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • Formal project management certification

  • Experience in tech, biotech, a CRO or a data-heavy R&D organisation

  • Scientific understanding in tumor biology, target discovery or 3D cell models

  • Familiarity with biobank or lab operations, and with data and omics pipelines (teams working in GitHub and AWS). You do not need to code, but you should understand how the work flows.

  • Experience managing external vendors, consortia, or grant-funded programs

  • Experience setting up PMO structure, cadence, and reporting automation from scratch

  • French is a plus (the team is based in Paris)

How we work

  • We all win when the team moves together, not is silos

  • We build our capabilities as products, with owners and a clear reason to exist: clinical impact

  • We would rather plan around a bottleneck three months out than firefight it, so raising risk early is expected and welcome

  • We want you to build, challenge, and follow metrics that reflect reality and drive decisions, not decorating slides

  • We have a feedback culture based on authentic and honest communication, where challenge and pushback are welcomed

What you will find at Orakl

Orakl Oncology is a dynamic, flexible, passionate and highly interdisciplinary team. If you want to interact with stellar clinicians, biologists and engineers on a day-to-day basis to transform oncology research, this is the place for you!

You will find:

  • Mission: Work in a cutting-edge environment, on the cutting-edge of cancer research.

  • Growth opportunities: we’re rapidly expanding the scope of our work and you will be offered multiple opportunities to grow with it!

  • Impact: you’re going to be participating in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project with multiple opportunities to shape it according to your interests.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership

Internal tooling is not a backlog item at Prelude — it's a strategic lever. As we scale from 50 to a much larger team, the speed at which engineering, ops, sales, support, and finance can operate depends on the tools we put in their hands.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Enterprise I Paris
jobs.description:
About us

Every company that scales lives or dies by its procurement function. It manages the vendor relationships that keep operations running, the financial guardrails that prevent overspend, and the supply chain resilience that determines whether a company survives a crisis or folds under one. And yet, the people doing this work spend 80% of their time in spreadsheets. Not because they lack ambition, because the tools haven't changed in 25 years.


Pivot is building the AI operating system for procurement: enterprise-grade infrastructure that hands the manual grind to AI agents so procurement teams can do what they were actually hired to do, shape the strategic future of their companies. Our platform combines intake, approvals, vendor management, invoice matching, and ERP integrations in a single AI-native platform.


We've lived this frustration firsthand. We built Pivot because we couldn't find what we needed, and because we believe procurement shouldn't be the last function to enter the AI era. It should be the first.


The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo) and highly experienced engineers from top-notch tech companies. We’ve since raised $40M in a Series B round, totaling our funding to $70M, coming from tier-1 investors. We’ve built a team of 70, are operating across 25+ countries, and are trusted by enterprise leaders like DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt, and Flix


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, surfacing upsell and cross-sell potential to grow revenue and deepen relationships.

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline: own your forecast with accuracy on a monthly and quarterly basis, and manage CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

  • Collaborate internally:

    • Work closely with the BDR team, providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to maximise the quality and volume of enterprise pipeline.

    • Partner with Pre-Sales to manage technical evaluations, RFPs, and InfoSec requirements during complex sales cycles.

    • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term client satisfaction post-close.

Your sales mindset

  • You are a master of enterprise sales cycles: multi-threaded stakeholder management and driving consensus across large, complex organisations come naturally to you.

  • You are a strategic thinker who approaches your territory like a business: mapping white space, prioritising high-potential accounts, and building plans to convert them methodically over time.

  • You are confident and credible at C-suite level, able to engage procurement directors and CFOs.

  • You are resilient and persistent: long sales cycles don't discourage you. You manage momentum, keep deals alive, and know how to re-engage accounts that have gone quiet.

  • You are naturally curious and want to actively solve customer problems.

  • You are commercially sharp, able to understand complex pricing structures and articulate ROI and TCO in a way that resonates with financially-driven buyers.

  • You are a collaborative leader who uplifts those around you: sharing knowledge with BDRs, working closely with pre-sales, and contributing to a culture of high performance.

  • You always want to keep learning and you are comfortable with confronting ideas.

  • You enjoy the cadence and want to bring the best of yourself within an early-staged startup.

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals.

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

  • PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.

  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Data Intelligence Applications (m/f/d)

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the Role

You will own and build the customer-facing layer of our platform: a portfolio of data intelligence products for hospitals, as well as the shared application framework beneath them.

As the senior technical lead for this area, you will operate with high agency—designing how data is queried, cached, and visualized, building API layers over platform services, and working directly with domain experts to translate complex methodology into intuitive, high-impact products.

  • Data-Access & Performance Strategy: Design robust caching, materialization, pagination, and streaming patterns to serve complex analytics from cloud data warehouses with low latency and optimized compute cost.

  • Advanced Data Visualization: Build interactive, non-standard visualization interfaces (e.g., hospital performance benchmarking and peer comparison views) and establish reusable patterns for the broader portfolio.

  • AI-Mediated Interfaces: Implement natural language and LLM-driven application surfaces—including retrieval workflows, tool integration, structured outputs, streaming, and evaluation of latency and cost.

Qualifications

  • Advanced Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building custom, interactive visualizations (working with scales, layouts, coordinate systems directly using D3.js alongside Visx, ECharts, or Vega-Lite) and choosing appropriate render targets (SVG, Canvas, WebGL).

  • Analytical SQL & Warehouse Caching: Strong analytical SQL skills (window functions, CTEs, multi-level aggregations) and practical experience designing materialization/caching strategies over columnar cloud warehouses.

  • Client-Side State & Data Management: Expertise with client-side caching, request coalescing, streaming, and table virtualization (e.g., TanStack Query, SWR).

Your Profile

jobs.title: Customs Specialist (Europe)
jobs.description:
Location: Fully remote in Europe

Working Hours: Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our Mission 🎯

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

About the Role 🤔

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform

  • Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product

  • Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework

  • Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found

  • Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately

  • Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

  • Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane

  • Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping

  • Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)

  • Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically

  • Extensive US import-export experience is required.

  • Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume

  • Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy

  • Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook

  • Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams

  • A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)

  • Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics

  • Experience with Indian export processes

  • Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll be doing

As Group CFO, you will serve as the primary financial strategist and a key partner to the CEO, shaping Satispay’s international financial roadmap from our Milan headquarters.
Your mandate includes overseeing the Group’s financial strategy, capital allocation and consolidated finance activities, supporting the company’s growth and future capital markets objectives.
You will lead and scale a best-in-class Group Finance organisation, spanning FP&A, Financial Control, Group Reporting, Investor Relations, and Finance Business Partnering capabilities, while ensuring consistent financial governance and alignment across all entities, including our regulated financial activities in Luxembourg.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Executive Financial Strategy: Act as a primary member of the Executive Team, influencing corporate development, monetisation plans, and the overarching business model.

  • Corporate Finance & Capital Management: Lead all corporate finance activities including equity fundraising, debt structuring, investor relations, M&A execution, financial due diligence, and valuation processes. Act as a key interface with the Board, shareholders, and institutional investors, supporting IPO preparation or capital markets readiness initiatives.

  • Financial Reporting & Governance: Oversee Group financial reporting, including consolidated accounts, statutory reporting, and financial governance across all entities. Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Regulatory & Compliance Division (RCD) at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal, compliance and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.

The EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger RCD function. We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. Our team culture is collaborative, impact-driven with a focus on continuous improvement. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, empowerment, and high performance.

This role is a newly created role with a specific focus on our UK business. This role will be a key member of the EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team, based in our London office with a direct line to the Senior Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK.

What you’ll do

As Senior Associate / Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK, you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the UK. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance through the communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, accurate execution and filing of regulatory reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, end-to-end management of regulatory examinations, and interfacing with UK regulators (including the FCA) on ad-hoc inquiries. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations, guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

  • Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators

  • Ensure that our regulatory compliance and regulatory reporting obligations are maintained for all Airwallex Group entities in the UK

  • Support and / or manage on-site exams, inspections and audits (in collaboration with our RCD colleagues)

  • Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new and evolving UK laws and FCA rules

  • Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the 1st line business

  • Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. governance forums and board reporting)

  • Advise the business in relation to conduct risk, Consumer Duty, complaints governance (including Financial Ombudsman Service escalations), and ethics matters relating to our financial services licences

  • Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program through assisting with targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

  • Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

  • Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with regulatory compliance experience in a financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above (minimum 4 years for Senior Associate; minimum 6 years for Manager)

  • Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in the UK (specifically FCA-regulated environments)

  • Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

  • Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

  • Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff

  • Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments and e-money activity

  • Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory reporting, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

  • Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience dealing with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and handling escalations to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
