jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Business Analyst, Reporting & MIS (Private Banking)
AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Business Partnering
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Finance Business Partnering to join us at Pleo. In this role, you'll lead our entire Finance Business Partnering (FBP) team, driving strategic decisions, financial performance, and resource allocation across our entire business - connecting Go-To-Market (GTM), Product & Offering, and Enablement into one coherent financial lens. As we scale, you will establish a new standard for strategic finance, balancing rigorous challenges with valued operational support to the business.
If you're excited about bringing commercial and strategic insight to high-growth teams, developing a talented finance team, and leveraging modern data and AI workflows to transform decision-making, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our CFO and work closely with C-suite and senior leaders across the entire organization (including the Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Product & Technology Officer and Chief People Officer and their respective leadership teams). You will directly lead and develop our team of Finance Business Partners, fostering a culture of ownership and strategic impact.
You’ll also operate as a close partner to the Director of Finance Platform to ensure Business Finance and Finance Platform operate with unified standards, zero friction, and one coherent voice.

What you’ll be doing

As Director of Finance Business Partnering, you will:

  • Drive Strategic Finance Partnering Across All Functions: Serve as a trusted strategic peer to C-level executives, translating operational and commercial realities into robust financial plans.

  • Bridge Product, Monetization & GTM: Connect product roadmap investments and feature choices directly to monetization, commercial deal structures, and go-to-market execution.

  • Lead Financial Planning & Performance Support: Drive annual budgeting, scenario modeling, resource allocation, and forecasting cycles across all business areas, shifting conversations from backward-looking reporting to forward-looking, decision-oriented action.

  • Lead & Evolve the FBP Team: Coach, mentor, and elevate a well-performing team of Finance Business Partners, setting clear capability standards, and fostering a curious, data- and impact-driven culture.

  • Leverage Data & Modern Workflows: Practical application of modern BI, analytics, and available AI tools to enhance and streamline commercial modeling, reduce manual work, and deliver faster insights.


To put things into context, we are actively focusing on rapid and sustainable topline growth, efficiency, and connecting product investment directly to bottom-line growth. You can expect to work with modern commercial data, BI, and AI-driven workflows alongside standard ERP, CRM, and FP&A tools.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Broad Finance Business Partnering Leadership: Senior experience leading finance business partnering across multiple major functions (GTM, Product, and/or central enablement functions) within a SaaS or scale-up environment.

  • Proven Finance Business Partner excellence: Proven track record designing and implementing best-in-class FBP frameworks across SaaS/scale-up environments. You know how to best define end-to-end partnerships across GTM, Product, and Enablement, establishing clear financial insights, decision-making, and accountability while leveraging modern data and AI workflows to elevate team output.

  • SaaS & Subscription Economics Fluency: Deep fluency in recurring revenue drivers, growth/efficiency trade-offs, and core SaaS metrics (ARR, CAC/LTV, retention, payback, sales capacity, pipeline, and product margin economics).

  • C-Suite Influence & Communication: Proven ability to partner with and challenge executive leadership, framing choices clearly and turning complex data into structured, actionable guidance.

  • People Leadership & Capability Building: A track record of assessing, coaching, and developing an existing finance team, helping individuals elevate their strategic impact through organizational change.

  • Strategic Planning & Commercial Judgment: High proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business case development in fast-paced, ambiguous scale-up environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to lead end-to-end finance business partnering with senior business leaders, directly shaping how product, commercial, and operational strategy translate into resource allocation and growth.

  • You enjoy building and mentoring teams, establishing high standards, and helping finance professionals grow into strategic business partners.

  • You thrive in fast-paced scale-up environments, turning ambiguity into structured, data-led choices without needing rigid enterprise playbooks.


How do you drive impact:

In your first 6-12 months at Pleo, you will step in to stabilize and elevate our entire Finance Business Partnering function. You’ll start building trust across C-level leadership, and establishing a seamless interface with Finance Platform. As you’ll settle, you’ll connect our product roadmap decisions to commercial execution, will drive higher standards for executive decision-making and lastly, you’ll build a high-performing FBP team equipped for Pleo’s next stage of international scale.

The location

Please note: We can hire on hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert (Denmark, United Kingdom, Spain and Portugal) but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.


Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • We offer 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards)

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our CFO about the role and needs.

  • Pleo Peer Interviews: Two separated 60-minute Peer chats with our Senior stakeholders with some real life case scenarios.

  • Final Stage: A 30-minute chat with our CRO and our CPO.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a senior Finance leader, we received a high volume of applications, but only a selective group were invited to an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI, it’s a big focus for us internally too - but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. Including links to your previous companies' websites is also a huge help!

  • Application care: Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. Take time to tailor your responses to show how your experience specifically intersects with broad business finance, commercial operations, product economics, and team development.

  • Profile to role fit: For this role specifically, candidates who lack experience partnering across multiple business functions, or who are narrow functional specialists without SaaS unit economics fluency, often miss the mark. We need someone who can lead across GTM, Product, and Enablement, challenging executives and elevating business decisions, not just traditional P&L oversight.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Member of Product Staff, Product Designer
jobs.description:
Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.

Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust.

We have one value: velocity.

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll design

Day to day, you'll own:

  • the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels

  • interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker

  • the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on

  • fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it

  • the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable

What you'll own

In your first 3–6 months, you should:

  • own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering

  • set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows

  • turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight

  • raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're likely to be excited by people who:

  • have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments

  • are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level

  • have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change

  • care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers

  • want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces

  • design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems

  • AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation

  • a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know — San Francisco

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the SF market: salary plus meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct, and it's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • Simplified leveling: early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games.

  • Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market twice a year and move comp up when it drifts, so "top 10%" stays true after your start date too.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. Raises are tied to a real change in the work, not an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's truly competitive. World-class option grants so we're all owners. The structure stays simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Health, fully covered. 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, for you and your dependents.

  • Unlimited time off. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Client Education team

Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from.

The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace.

We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling.

  • Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.

  • Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform.

  • Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one.

  • Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard.

  • Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from.

  • Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience.

  • Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background.

  • Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure.

  • Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you.

  • Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief.

 

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you.

  • You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.

 

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview Process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off (30 minutes)

  2. Manager interview with Dom (60 minutes)

  3. Practical training assessment: build and present a short curriculum plan for a real hx feature, followed by discussion (60-90 minutes)

  4. Values interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter (gn) Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung
jobs.description:
Technical Recruiter (gn), remote, vollzeit, ab sofort.

Du erkennst, ob hinter einem technischen Profil die Erfahrung steckt, die ein Projekt wirklich braucht? Und du hast Freude daran, passende Menschen zu finden und für eine Zusammenarbeit zu gewinnen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Wir suchen eine_n_ Technical Recruiter (gn)_, der/_die uns bei der Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen unterstützt. Aktuell liegt der Schwerpunkt auf Softwareentwicklung. Perspektivisch suchen wir auch für Rollen im Produkt- und Projektumfeld, etwa Product Owner, Projektmanager:_innen und Business Analyst:_innen.

New Monday ist eine UX/UI-Agentur aus Berlin. Wir arbeiten an digitalen Produkten für Unternehmen wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP und Lufthansa sowie für junge Unternehmen wie NUMA Stays. Unser Team arbeitet zu 100% remote. Dabei setzen wir auf eigenständiges Arbeiten, kurze Wege und einen engen Austausch miteinander – digital und immer öfter auch bei persönlichen Treffen.

Aufgaben

  • Du begleitest die Besetzung unserer technischen Positionen – aktuell vor allem in der Softwareentwicklung, perspektivisch auch in Rollen wie Product Ownership, Projektmanagement und Business Analyse.
  • Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, ordnest Profile fachlich ein und beurteilst, wie gut Erfahrung und Projekthintergrund zu unseren Anforderungen passen.
  • Bei Bedarf findest du passende Kandidat*innen über LinkedIn und weitere Recruiting-Kanäle und sprichst sie persönlich an.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche und klärst technische Erfahrung, Motivation sowie Rahmendaten wie Verfügbarkeit und Gehaltsvorstellung.
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unseren fachlichen Ansprechpartner:innen ab, bereitest Interviews vor und begleitest Kandidat:innen verbindlich durch den gesamten Prozess.
  • Du pflegst unsere Bewerbungsprozesse im Bewerbersystem und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen an den Schnittstellen zwischen Recruiting, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung zuverlässig fließen.
  • Du beobachtest den Markt und gibst uns Rückmeldung, wie wir unsere Suche und Ansprache verbessern können.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Recruiting und Active Sourcing technischer Fachkräfte und hast insbesondere Positionen in der Softwareentwicklung bereits erfolgreich besetzt.
  • Du verstehst die Unterschiede zwischen Frontend-, Backend- und Fullstack-Profilen und kannst praktische Projekterfahrung gezielt hinterfragen. Idealerweise kennst du auch Profile aus dem Produkt- und Projektumfeld.
  • Begriffe wie Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST-APIs, CI/CD und Kubernetes sind dir vertraut. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln können, kannst technische Lebensläufe aber sicher einordnen und mit Kandidat*innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit Bewerbermanagementsystemen und digitalen Recruiting-Tools. Erfahrung mit JOIN ist ein Plus.
  • Du kommunizierst wertschätzend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl schriftlich als auch im Gespräch.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und transparent und behältst mehrere Suchprozesse gleichzeitig im Blick.
  • Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Ansprache und die Organisation deiner Arbeit einzusetzen und prüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • 100 % remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands von dem Ort aus, der für dich passt.
  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig, mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und ohne Micromanagement.
  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zusammen.
  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.
  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir dabei regelmäßig mit dir.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.
  • Arbeit mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung ein und hilfst uns, unser Recruiting für technische Rollen weiterzuentwickeln.

So geht es weiter

  • Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday und die Rolle. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind.
  • Gespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti: Wir lernen uns ausführlicher kennen und sprechen darüber, wie du technische Recruiting-Prozesse gestaltest und mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammenarbeiten würdest.
  • Fachliches Follow-up: Anhand konkreter Recruiting-Situationen sprechen wir darüber, wie du Bewerbungen einschätzt, passende Kandidat*innen findest und Entscheidungen vorbereitest. Du bekommst außerdem Gelegenheit, mit einer Person aus dem Team unter vier Augen zu sprechen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst.

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

jobs.title: Senior IT Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei virtual7 verbinden wir unsere technologische Expertise mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Durch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen schaffen wir einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Rahmenvertragspartner in der öffentlichen Verwaltung. Aktuell suchen wir für einen unserer Kunden einen Senior IT Architect (m/w/d).

  • Projektstandort: Bonn

  • Zeitraum: 2. November 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2026

  • Arbeitsmix: 30 Tage Remote/ 5 Tage vor Ort

  • Wichtig: Remote-Arbeit nur in Deutschland möglich

  • Wichtig: Projektsprache in deutsch

  • Wichtig: Bereitschaft zur SÜ2 nach § 9 SÜG Geheim/Sabotageschutz

  • Verlängerung für 2027 möglich

DEINE MISSION

Bei unserem Kunden wird im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung einer Cloud an Konzeption und dem Aufbau eines zentralen Repositories für Software gearbeitet. In der Anlage erfolgt ein Aufbau zunächst für den OpenSouce Cloud Stack, es sollen aber Konzepte und Proof of Conzepts für any Software on any Platform entwickelt werden. Für diese Software Produkte müssen Funktions- und Lasttests in der Cloud konzipiert und erprobt werden.

Die Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Analyse funktionaler und nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen. Identifikation von technischen Rahmenbedingungen und Schnittstellen.

  • Entwurf von Systemkomponenten, Schnittstellen und Datenflüssen.

  • Analyse interner und externer Abhängigkeiten zwischen Modulen, Services und Drittsystemen.

  • Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Abhängigkeiten auf Wartbarkeit, Erweiterbarkeit und Release-Zyklen.

  • Definition von Integrationsstrategien z. B. API-Gateways, Adapter, Service Mesh.

  • Recherche und Bewertung alternativer Technologien, Frameworks oder Produkte.

  • Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen z. B. Pro/Contra-Tabellen, Proof-of-Concepts.

  • Risikoanalyse bei Migration oder Einführung neuer Lösungen.

  • Erstellung eines Plans zur Containerisierung bestehender oder neuer Komponenten.

  • Bewertung von Eignung zur Containerisierung Statefulness, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcenverbrauch.

  • Definition von Vorgaben für Containerisierung.

  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation.

  • Architektur-Reviews, DevOps-Unterstützung

  • Sicherstellung von Performance, Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit.

  • Integration von Authentifizierung, Autorisierung und Verschlüsselung.

  • Umsetzung von Security-by-Design und Privacy-by-Design.

  • Technische Abstimmung mit Dev-Teams, Operations, Product Ownern und externen Partnern.

  • Präsentation und Verteidigung von Architekturentscheidungen vor Management oder Kunden.

MUST-HAVES FÜR DIESE POSITION

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Kubernetes Anwendungen

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Analyse und Bewertung von Legacy Software für Migration in Cloud Environments

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Anforderungsanalyse und Systementwurf von Air Gap Container Repositories

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Entwurf von Testszenarien für migrierte Legacy Software in der Cloud Zielplattform

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Code Version Control / GIT

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Praxiserfahrung in DevOps oder DevSecOps

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Linux Umfeld

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Diagnose und Fehlerbehebung in produktiven Enterprise-Infrastrukturen

NICE TO-HAVES FÜR DIESE POSITION

  • UML-Modellierung ADM

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Merchandising UK
Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

You will build Orbem's legal and compliance function largely from the ground up, at a pivotal moment. As we scale across Europe, into the US, and toward new geographies and verticals, legal and compliance touch nearly every part of the business — commercial contracts, corporate matters, employment, data protection, and product & AI regulation. Much of this exists today only in pieces. You will inherit that reality and the mandate to shape it into a coherent function.

This is a role for a hands-on legal counsel who wants to build a function, not just run one — someone comfortable with ambiguity, who makes pragmatic, risk-balanced calls with incomplete information, and does the substantive legal work themselves while orchestrating a lean stack of external counsel.

A central part of the role is building Orbem's compliance function: a cross-functional, integrated approach to knowing and managing our risks — across intellectual property, product compliance, information security, data protection, and regulatory readiness. We treat compliance as an enabler of speed, not a brake on it — applying the right level of rigour for our stage and moment, so Orbem stays compliant and moves fast.

Your Day-to-Day

Legal & Commercial (≈ 40%)

  • Draft and negotiate our commercial contracts — the integrated hardware sale/lease, software/AI licensing, and service/maintenance agreements at the core of our B2B business, plus supplier and partner agreements.

  • Build and own our contract toolkit — templates, playbooks, and a clean review-to-signing workflow that lets the business move quickly without losing rigour.

  • Own corporate and governance matters, including corporate housekeeping, board and shareholder support, and our employee equity program.

  • Advise on employment matters and manage disputes and litigation in partnership with external counsel.

Building the Compliance Function (≈ 40%)

  • Stand up Orbem's cross-functional compliance function — an integrated approach to identifying, aligning on, and managing risk across the business, rather than in silos.

  • Partner across IP, InfoSec, Product Compliance, and Data Protection to translate obligations into practical, proportionate standards people can actually work with.

  • Drive regulatory readiness for the frameworks that matter to us — EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, export control, data protection — sequencing what we do to our stage.

  • Own the foundational building blocks — Code of Conduct and core policies as enablers of trust and speed.

Orchestrating External Counsel & Lateral Leadership (≈ 20%)

  • Manage a lean stack of external firms (e.g. corporate, US, employment counsel), optimizing for cost, consistency, and a coherent global strategy.

  • Be the central hub for legal and compliance across Orbem — looped in early on decisions, not as a final gatekeeper.

  • Embed legal as a proactive enabler in fast-moving business workflows, and leverage AI and legal tooling aggressively to keep the function lean and scalable.

How You Fit In

This is an individual contributor role at Principal level, reporting to the COO. Your influence is lateral, not hierarchical — you work across the whole company rather than through a team of your own. You partner closely with Information Security, Intellectual Property, and Product Compliance on the integrated compliance approach, and work day to day with Finance, People & Culture, Supply Chain, Business Development, Field Operations, and our Product teams. You advise the full executive team on legal- and compliance-relevant decisions.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Qualified German lawyer — Volljurist or Wirtschaftsjurist (or equivalent) — with strong in-house experience in a fast-paced environment.

  • Solid foundation in German corporate and commercial contract law, with a focus on B2B operations.

  • Hands-on builder. You have personally set up legal and/or compliance processes, templates, and frameworks — not only specified or overseen them. You are comfortable drafting, running workshops, and sitting in working meetings to ship the work.

  • Comfort without a large team. You are motivated by being the person in the room, not the person who built the room.

  • Business-minded and pragmatic. You make risk-balanced decisions, understand the need for speed in a scale-up, and offer solutions rather than just flagging problems.

  • Cross-border comfort. You are comfortable coordinating multi-jurisdictional matters, especially across the EU and US, in partnership with external counsel.

  • Communication. You translate complex legal issues into practical, commercially sound advice for non-legal stakeholders. Fluent in German and English.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • In-house experience at a hardware-focused technology company or a deep-tech scale-up.

  • Track record building compliance frameworks from scratch — ideally an integrated, company-wide approach rather than a single domain — across areas such as data protection, product and trade compliance, anti-corruption, or AI governance.

  • Experience with product liability and product safety in a commercial context.

  • Comfort with AI-first working — using AI to compress the work and owning the output, not just the prompt.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

Wir suchen keine Verwalter, sondern Gestalter. In Dortmund schlagen wir das nächste Kapitel auf und suchen jemanden, der unser lokales Team nicht nur führt, sondern gemeinsam mit uns wächst.

 

Deine Rolle: Mitmacher, Stratege & Mentor

Du bist das Gesicht von Salonkee in Dortmund. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ein schlagkräftiges Team aufzubauen und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass wir nah am Kunden bleiben.

  • Teamaufbau & Coaching: Du baust das Team auf ca. fünf Talente aus. Du führst keine Excel-Tabellen, sondern Menschen - durch 1:1s, gemeinsames Training und echtes Feedback.

  • Präsenz im Markt: Du bist kein Büromensch. Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen vor Ort, unterstützt bei der Kaltakquise und zeigst in Live-Demos, wie Salonkee den Alltag der Salonbesitzer erleichtert.

  • Struktur schaffen: Du organisierst die Woche so, dass dein Team Erfolg haben kann. Du behältst die CRM-Pflege und die Kennzahlen im Blick, um frühzeitig zu sehen, wo wir nachjustieren können.

  • Vorbildfunktion: Gerade am Anfang bist du selbst aktiv im Verkauf tätig. Nicht, um Rekorde zu brechen, sondern um den Markt in Dortmund im Detail zu verstehen.

 

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Außendienst: Du hast 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise B2B) gesammelt und weißt, wie man Türen öffnet.

  • Lust auf Führung: Du musst noch kein „Director“ gewesen sein, aber du hast das Talent, andere zu motivieren und Verantwortung für gemeinsame Ziele zu übernehmen.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und weißt, wie man Prioritäten setzt.

  • Kommunikation: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst dich sicher auf Englisch mit unserem internationalen Team austauschen.

  • Mobilität: Für die Termine bei unseren Partnern vor Ort ist ein Führerschein notwendig.

 

Warum Salonkee?

  • Sicherheit & Erfolg: Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket aus Fixum & Provision, das deine Leistung wirklich belohnt.

  • Dein Firmenwagen: Auch zur privaten Nutzung - damit du immer flexibel bleibst.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

Business Development Representative - Spanish Speaking
jobs.description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

As a core member of our Sales team, you’ll connect with a wide range of prospects and spark their interest in our authentication tech. You’ll be on the front lines of our growth engine, partnering with AEs and other BDRs to uncover opportunities, start meaningful conversations, fuel a steady pipeline of qualified leads, and own the full lifecycle for smaller deals.

What you'll do

As a Business Development Representative, you’ll focus on getting companies excited about our product. You’ll be reaching out to prospects across every level - from procurement managers and lead engineers to heads of anti-fraud, platform owners, CTOs, CPOs, and even CEOs. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Generating new sales opportunities for Prelude

  • Identifying companies and people to target within your verticals/territories

  • Cold calling and emailing as well as experimenting with other channels to find new leads

  • Qualifying leads and pitching Prelude's value proposition

  • Closing smaller deals independently

  • Maintaining a clean CRM

  • Improving processes as we scale our business

About you:

  • You have 6 months to 1 year of BDR or sales experience, ideally selling a technical product at a startup, scale-up, or SaaS company

  • You can handle the friction and challenges of cold calling and outbound prospecting

  • Solid understanding of qualification fundamentals

  • Able to understand technical concepts and translate them into business terms

  • A proactive mindset, with a drive to start conversations, build momentum, and close deals

  • Structured and rigorous in managing your pipeline, CRM hygiene, and performance metrics

  • You know your way around HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Apollo, RingOver, or Kaspr

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, taking initiative and finding solutions

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an excellent team player

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn by doing

  • Fluency in selling a technical product in Spanish

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package (base + uncapped commission)

  • Comprehensive health insurance plan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • 100% transport subsidised

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Pet-friendly office environment

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

  • Laptop and equipment needed to do the role

  • Hybrid working style: 4 days at the office and 1 day at home, with 4 weeks of remote working per year

  • An annual offsite in a great location (last one was at Le Pradet)

Interview process

  • Call with recruiter

  • Call with a Sales team member

  • Case study

  • A visit to our offices to meet the team and interview with our CEO

We don't expect you to ace all these stages - we will evaluate your creativity and how you approach difficult problems. You should consider applying even if you don't meet all the criteria; we'll carefully review all of the applications we receive.

Compensation: €57K • Offers Commission

jobs.title: EXTERNAL TEMPLATE - Hybrid adverts
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, unlocking the full potential of our cutting-edge solutions for businesses across Europe & the UK. Your mission is to oversee and execute the onboarding process for our largest customers with precision and finesse, collaborating seamlessly with both customers and internal teams to ensure a smooth and memorable journey from start to finish.

As the bridge between technology and human connection, understanding each customer's unique requirements, and configuring Pleo to match their needs perfectly, you'll be the go-to expert for technical queries, providing consultation, sharing best practices, and conducting training to drive user adoption that allows our customers to take their business to new levels. Your role goes beyond just technical prowess – it's about building strong relationships and ensuring customer success becomes a powerful reference point for the world to see. Your genuine curiosity and exceptional problem-solving skills will shine through as you navigate multiple onboarding projects with ease.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing implementations, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Onboarding, High-Touch Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Success

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.
You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo is implemented connected to the customer’s strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you will:

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Align with our customers on project timelines, scope, resources, and integration requirements

  • Configure Pleo for users, including activation, limits, cards, integration, and compliance

  • Integrate Pleo with the customer's accounting system, export expenses, and help test

  • Provide consulting, share best practices, conduct training and help drive user adoption

  • Assist in preparing data, communication, policies, and guides

  • Provide 'hyper care', conduct final review calls, facilitate handover to the dedicate Customer Success Manager.

  • Maintain strong relationships, gather feedback and CES scores

  • Assist in capturing testimonials or references

  • Accurately track efforts for revenue recognition and resource allocation

  • Provide feedback and insights to product, development, and marketing teams

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, share updates, address risks

  • Ensure onboarding timeline and customer satisfaction

  • Facilitate clear, documented and structured Handovers to Customer Success

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct mid-market or enterprise customer onboarding or customer success experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Excellent planning, prioritisation, and risk management abilities for simultaneous onboarding projects

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • A structured and proactive approach to project management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

    Nice to have

    • Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

    • Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

    • Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

    • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

    • Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

    • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

    • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are able to build and execute detailed project plans.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing risks.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge with the team, collaborating on training and enablement

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

jobs.description:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend.

You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability.

  • Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components.

  • Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies.

  • Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there.

  • Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript.

  • Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals.

  • Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS.

  • Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty.

  • Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices.

  • Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear.

  • An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up).

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers.

  • Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.
